name: reggae_one
description: Reggae is a very popular display font often used in Japanese boys' magazines and digital content. The sharpened ends give off a dynamic pulse, making this font ideal to express rhythm, movement and energy, or for emphasis. To contribute to the project, visit github.com/fontworks-fonts/Reggae
